text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Maritime radiocommunication examinations", "gist": "The text is about maritime radiocommunication examinations"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In accordance with the International Radio Regulations, anyone who uses radiocommunications equipment on a seagoing vessel must be the holder of a licence and a certificate of competency permitting him or her to use the equipment in question.", "gist": "Users of maritime radiocommunication equipment must hold a licence and certificate of competency"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "OFCOM", "gist": "OFCOM is the organizer of the examinations"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Further information on the examinations, examination dates, registration forms and on the list of organisers of courses is available only in German, Italian and French.", "gist": "Additional details about exams are only available in German, Italian, and French"}]}
